_about: The shared topic list every MadAsMaths question is tagged to once (scripts/booklets/tag.py), and each question bank's map from it to the bank's own topics. A question goes into a bank only where one of its topics maps to one of the bank's; null means the bank's specification doesn't have it (Poisson for Edexcel A-Level Maths). A new bank is a new map here, not a re-tag. 'level' says where the topic is first taught: 'maths' (A-Level Maths) or 'further' (Further Maths only), as a hint to taggers.

topics.title: Proof
topics.text: proof by deduction, exhaustion, counter-example, contradiction; proving a result in general
